profile.summary: The parent-teacher association (PTA) of Montclair Elementary School in Oakland, California. It is a partnership of parents and educators that raises money to support school programs such as library, music, art, drama and computer science, as well as field trips and classroom supplies. The PTA has operated at the school since 1926.

sources.title: Montclair Elementary PTA - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The OUSD school page for Montclair Elementary's PTA confirms the summary, address, phone, website and 1926 history, and ProPublica lists 'Montclair Elementary Pta' (AKA) in Oakland under EIN 94-6183886 as a 501(c)(3). This matches the donation-giving PTA named in the agenda, and the profile contains no named-individual contacts.
